prompts.clean:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready STATIC desktop utility illustration for CPlus Cleaner, used on the right side of a white Windows application. Style: polished premium 2.5D / isometric soft 3D illustration, translucent frosted glass and softly rounded satin plastic, soft top-left studio lighting, restrained contact shadow. Matching series palette: mint green #46D6A0, pale aqua #BDEFF0, milky white, small accents of deep teal #246766. The form must remain legible when reduced to about 280 pixels. Composition: one compact, centered, balanced complete object cluster, gently isometric viewpoint, all objects fully in frame, ample transparent margins on every side. Real transparent alpha background, no colored background, no floor plane, no rectangular card, no baked checkerboard. Keep any small grounding shadow subtle and translucent. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI buttons, watermarks, people, characters, rockets or rubbish bins. No animation, no animation frames, no motion blur. Portrait-friendly composition to fit a 300 by 330 pixel UI slot.
Subject: disk space cleanup. A pale aqua circular computer storage disk / platter standing at a gentle angle on a small rounded white storage enclosure. A clear mint-green translucent scanning orbit arcs around the disk. A few small aqua cache blocks above the upper-right edge fragment into only a few tiny mint particles, suggesting reclaimed space. The disk and its elegant green orbit are the dominant simple silhouette; the disappearing blocks are secondary. Keep it calm, clean, luminous and professional, not a busy sci-fi scene. One isolated illustration only.

Subject: moving large files between disks. Two small rounded translucent pale-aqua storage enclosures on the same isometric diagonal, one at the back-left and the destination at the front-right. A prominent frosted mint file folder and two simple white document slabs sit between the drives, with a single elegant curved mint transfer arrow connecting the source to the destination. Use a broad, readable folder silhouette and a clearly visible transfer direction. No document writing or symbols. Keep the enclosure design minimal and softly rounded, matching a disk-cleanup illustration of a pale-aqua disk, mint orbit and white enclosure. One isolated illustration only.
